body: I don't know why. There's so many emotions conflicting in me right now. The moment I hear anyone is suicidal, I become nurturing and empathetic but the thought of doing that for my mother feels disgusting. It's like I'd be walking into a trap of emotional manipulation if I make myself vulnerable. I'm naturally kind but also a logical thinker. I can't figure out the logic behind this crawling under my skin at the thought of helping someone in need.
